quests.title: Snowy Silhouette: Hope

dialogue.t: Will I really find Dad this time...
Oh, it's you!
Pallad told me that Uncle Cyrus might have found some news about my dad.
He can't be sure yet, but according to Pallad, their latest leads seem pretty promising, so they might just find him.
I'd love to go up Dragonspine with them, but Uncle Cyrus says that I should stay in the camp, and that they'll tell me once they get more news...
Could you help me look for Uncle Cyrus and ask him, please?
I... I'm afraid that the news... might be bad...
Either way... I'm counting on you!
In this area, huh... Are you sure, Pallad?
I'm very sure, Mr. Cyrus.
Ah, if it isn't the Traveler! Joel sent you, I'll wager.
That child has asked someone to come ask us for news practically every day...
This time, though... We've got some good news for him, haha!
Previously, we were organizing some special training on Dragonspine...
It might be best if I explained the rest, Mr. Cyrus.
So, while taking part in that training, I wound up straying from the arranged path due to a huge blizzard.
As I was groping my way back on track, I saw a blurred silhouette on a cliff.
I thought that this must be a lost adventurer, just like myself, so I yelled for their attention.
Unfortunately, before I could attract that person's attention... My cries attracted some monsters first.
Now I don't know about you, but I wasn't confident that I could take them on in such conditions, so I beat a hasty retreat.
Once I got back, I related the matter to Mr. Cyrus.

dialogue.sit: So the person you saw was Joel's father?
That could have been any old lost adventurer, you know...

dialogue.t: We're not sure ourselves.
Regardless, at least now we know that *someone* is trapped on Dragonspine. As such, I believe a rescue is in order.
Whether that person is Joel's father Joserf or not... Now that is up to fortune.
Either way, I've already dispatched all with the capability to explore Dragonspine to fan out and search.
I'll get ready as well.

dialogue.sit: I'll go beat those monsters up.

dialogue.t: Really? That's amazing! Let's head out together, then.
Please help me look for Uncle Cyrus and ask him...
There's little time to lose...
Well, at least this area's safe now. Thanks a lot.
Unfortunately, I didn't find anything earlier, either.
However, since the coast is clear, I'll continue my search now.
Would you mind helping me make a trip back to inform Mr. Cyrus that I've begun search efforts? Thanks!
Ah, Traveler, you've returned!

dialogue.sit: Will we really find that person?

dialogue.t: Has he now? Hah! I knew he always had a responsible bone in him somewhere...
Once I've finished the matters I have on hand, I'll go to Dragonspine to check on that boy Joel myself and give him the news.
So if you would, please tell him that I'll be right with him shortly.
It will take a moment for me to finish my work. Don't keep the lad waiting, now!
Hey there! What's the latest news?
Oh... So Uncle Cyrus hasn't found my dad yet, right?

dialogue.sit: Have a little faith in him.
They've got some clues, at least.

dialogue.t: I know... I'll ask Uncle Cyrus for more details when he gets here, then. Thanks a bunch!
Where are you, Daddy...
So if you would, please tell him that I'll be right with him shortly.
It will take a moment for me to finish my work. Don't keep the lad waiting, now!

quests.description: According to Joel, Cyrus has found some leads as to his father’s whereabouts…
